purpose: Literature constraint for the I-to-E synapse of the H01 measured pair (contact 8105899): human neocortical fast-spiking (parvalbumin) basket cell onto a layer 2/3 pyramidal cell. Values were read from the cited pages on 2026-09-07 (W4 of docs/specs/2026-09-07-h01-usable-circuit-plan.md); none is from memory.

sources.citation: Szegedi V, Paizs M, Baka J, Barzo P, Molnar G, Tamas G, Lamsa K. Robust perisomatic GABAergic self-innervation inhibits basket cells in the human and mouse supragranular neocortex. eLife 2020;9:e51691.

autaptic_decay_tau_ms.note: basket-cell autapse, same GABA-A receptors; used as the decay estimate because the BC-PC decay is not tabulated in the main text

sources.citation: Szegedi V, Molnar G, Paizs M, Csakvari E, Barzo P, Tamas G, Lamsa K. High-Precision Fast-Spiking Basket Cell Discharges during Complex Events in the Human Neocortex. eNeuro 2017;4(5):ENEURO.0260-17.2017.

fsbc_to_pc_ipsc_pa.where: Figure 4 and the Results section on GABAergic synaptic currents

conditions.internal: 126 K-gluconate, 4 KCl, 4 ATP-Mg, 0.3 Na2-GTP, 10 HEPES, 10 phosphocreatine (mM)

sources.citation: Molnar G, Olah S, Komlosi G, Fule M, Szabadics J, Varga C, Barzo P, Tamas G. Complex Events Initiated by Individual Spikes in the Human Cerebral Cortex. PLoS Biology 2008;6(9):e222.

decay_tau_ms.basis: szegedi2020 autaptic decay; BC-PC decay not tabulated

delay_ms.basis: szegedi2020 autaptic delay to AP peak; the network median 3.94 ms (szegedi2017) includes disynaptic steps

reversal_mv.basis: Nernst at 36 C for 8 mM internal and about 130 mM external chloride; the recordings' physiological [Cl]i. The circuit's -80 mV is an assumption 5 mV more negative.

unitary_ipsp_at_soma_mv.formula: g * (V - E) * R_in with R_in 102 MOhm (molnar2008), a slow-synapse upper bound for a somatic contact
unitary_ipsp_at_soma_mv.measured_in_human: not tabulated in the three sources as an IPSP in mV; the eNeuro IPSC of 27.6 pA at -55 mV with R_in 102 MOhm gives about 2.8 mV, consistent with the conductance median only if the effective driving force is about 9 mV, i.e. E near -64 mV in that recording configuration

circuit_today.note: 20 nS is 6.5 times the human median conductance; the measured pair nevertheless moves the E soma by 0.003 mV, so the deficit is the placement and cable, not the conductance
